## Loading...

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(stringr)

jcmr_articles <- read_csv("~/project-2/Final_CSV_Springer_Articles.csv")
```


## Cleaning


```{r}
#| echo: false
view(jcmr_articles)

test <- jcmr_articles |>
  distinct(volume, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(date = dmy(date),
         n_volume = str_extract(volume, "\\d{2}"),
         authors = str_squish(authors),
         authors = str_remove(authors, "Explore all metrics"))  

view(test)
```
